content.stem_en: What areas of laws and regulations have the greatest impact on AML/CFT applications? (Choose Three.)

options_en.A: Information security, data privacy, and cybersecurity.
options_en.B: Foreign exchange controls and precious gemstone and metal dealing.
options_en.D: Electronic contract and biometric signature acceptance.
options_en.E: Consumer protection, financial inclusion, and environmental, social, and governance.
